notes: Stasis Snare, printed: 'When this enchantment enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.' Cast for exactly {1}{W}{W}; its trigger exiles the opponent's 3/3. When the Snare is destroyed (moved to its owner's graveyard by another effect), the 3/3 returns to the battlefield under its owner's control (CR 610.3c).
